Hannah — forwarding some suggested clarifications for Alan's asks. Quoting his note below for context.

Proposed clarifications (to be included in our response and contract language):
1) Acknowledgement window: 24 hours from report receipt (acknowledgement defined as assigning a ticket and confirming initial triage completed).
2) Interim updates: We provide status updates every 24 hours until containment + investigation complete.
3) Confirmed breach notification: 72 hours from confirmation that customer data was materially accessed or exfiltrated. This matches our SOC2 incident handling controls.
4) Exception handling: If notification would materially impede a criminal investigation, notification may be delayed; we will provide written justification to the customer and notify our own regulators as required.

Team — suggested wording for the SOW/PSA appendix (draft):

"""
Incident Notification and Customer Communications
1. Acknowledgement: Redwood will acknowledge any reported security incident within 24 hours of receipt.
2. Interim Updates: Redwood will provide reasonably requested interim updates at intervals not to exceed 24 hours during active investigation.
3. Confirmed Breach Notice: When Redwood confirms that customer data was materially accessed, Redwood will issue written notice to the customer no later than 72 hours after such confirmation, except where Redwood reasonably determines that notification would materially impede a criminal investigation.
4. Points of Contact: Redwood will maintain a primary and backup security and legal contact for incident communications; contact details will be provided in the signature appendix and kept current.
"""

Please confirm if procurement needs an explicit SLA credit or remedy for missed notice windows — our default is to negotiate remedial steps rather than automatic credits. If GreenFintech insists on a liquidated damages-style remedy, ask procurement to specify the requested language and I'll review.

Also: we'll send a DocuSign amendment for the appendix if GreenFintech is comfortable with the above; link included in related links.

- Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
